rules.name: Risk tags are code, never model output
rules.description: Risk tags and routes derive from core/policy.py only. Any diff that lets model text set risk_tag, bypass the policy engine, or act on sensitive findings autonomously is a violation.

rules.name: Verification truth is a real test run
rules.description: A fix is verified only by a recorded pytest exit code. Any diff that marks verification passed without a subprocess or sandbox run result is a violation.

rules.name: Evidence refs must exist in the payload
rules.description: Summarizer evidence.ref values must be keys that literally exist in the finding payload. New fields added to payloads must be documented so refs stay valid.
